tool_suggestions.title: Client ROI Monitoring Dashboard
tool_suggestions.prompt: Create a dashboard to track and analyze client ROI including total investment, revenue, and leads generated over different periods.
features: Select client to view detailed ROI analysis
Filter ROI by specific periods (monthly, quarterly)
Visualize ROI multiple through interactive charts
Compare ROI performance against target metrics

tool_suggestions.title: Campaign Performance Tracker
tool_suggestions.prompt: Build a tool to monitor and assess the performance of campaigns including video metrics, audience engagement, and budget usage.
features: List active campaigns with key performance indicators
Drill down to view detailed video metrics (views, likes, shares)
Budget usage tracking versus campaign budget
Generate performance reports for specific timeframes

tool_suggestions.title: Team Resource Management Interface
tool_suggestions.prompt: Design an interface for team resource management, allowing allocation tracking and team performance insights in ongoing campaigns.
features: View team member roles and campaign assignments
Allocate and adjust team hours per campaign
Monitor hours utilization and efficiency metrics
Highlight resource over-allocation risks for early intervention
